content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES AM-Programmer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES AM-Programmer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RITES AM-Programmer recruitment is 17 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the AM-Programmer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the AM-Programmer post announced by RITES in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the AM-Programmer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the AM-Programmer position is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the AM-Programmer role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Full-time Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, EC&E or equivalent, or a Post Graduate Degree in Computer Application.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for RITES AM-Programmer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this RITES AM-Programmer recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the AM-Programmer post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the AM-Programmer post ranges from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 140,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for RITES AM-Programmer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Scrutiny/verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the RITES AM-Programmer job?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official RITES website or the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this AM-Programmer position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the RITES office located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a position in Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122001.
